label: Female / wife hypnosis scenes sweep (15 Oct 2026)
description: Scene-level sweep (YouTube clip titles/descriptions via yt-dlp metadata, episode guides) for adult women, especially wives, hypnotized on screen. Existing categories only. Each record names the episode/scene, the hypnotist and whether she is a wife.

records.title: Dallas
records.subtitle: S4E4 "Who Done It?" (aired 21 Nov 1980)
records.summary: Scene: S4E4 "Who Done It?". Sue Ellen Ewing, jailed after her fingerprints are found on the gun used to shoot her husband J.R., is put under hypnosis by her psychiatrist Dr. Simon Ellby to recover the night of the shooting; under hypnosis she remembers that her sister Kristin shot J.R. and framed her. Hypnotist: psychiatrist Dr. Ellby. Wife: yes (J.R. Ewing's wife).

episodes.title: Who Done It?
episodes.gist: Dr. Ellby hypnotizes Sue Ellen; she recalls Kristin shot J.R.

records.pregnancy_note: Not in this episode (Kristin, not Sue Ellen, is revealed pregnant by J.R.)
records.kids_note: Son John Ross Ewing III with J.R., born before this episode

sources.label: YouTube clip: Hypnosis Scene In Dallas - Sue Ellen Gets Hypnotized

records.evidence: Episode guides (TVmaze, Rotten Tomatoes, Dallas Decoder) + YouTube clip

records.title: Martin
records.subtitle: S4E23 "The Tooth Will Set You Free" (aired 28 Mar 1996)
records.summary: Scene: S4E23. Pam James is hypnotized by a dentist (Dr. Friendly, Steve White) for a painful dental procedure; because of Martin's interference she stays under and behaves like Martin whenever someone claps, including on her blind date at an artist's showing. Hypnotist: dentist. Wife: no (single).

episodes.title: The Tooth Will Set You Free
episodes.gist: Dentist hypnotizes Pam; clap trigger makes her act like Martin on her date

records.title: Mrs Brown's Boys
records.subtitle: S3E1 "Mammy's Spell" (aired 1 Jan 2013)
records.summary: Scene: S3E1 "Mammy's Spell". At the christening party for Dermot and Maria's triplets a stage hypnotist (Derek Mooney) puts widowed Agnes Brown and Winnie under; afterwards Agnes acts like an Alsatian dog at the word 'triplets' and a stripper at the word 'baptism'. Hypnotist: hired stage hypnotist. Wife: no (widow).

records.title: Cesur Hemşire
records.subtitle: Episode 2 (aired 8 Dec 2013)
records.summary: Scene: episode 2. The official NTC Medya clip 'Ceyda, hipnoz oluyor!' shows surgeon Ceyda, wife of 18 years of male nurse Cesur, being hypnotized. The atv episode synopsis says Cesur plans, with psychiatrist Babür, to use hypnosis to make Dr. Kenan confess to stealing their project, so Ceyda's hypnosis appears to be a side effect of that plan. Hypnotist: presumably psychiatrist Babür (not confirmed). Wife: yes.

episodes.title: 2. Bölüm

records.kids_note: 16-year-old twins Cömert and Canan with Cesur (born before the story)
